feedback.message: Treat QNDRF as current leading simplification candidate, but keep dedicated light embedding counterbaseline until matched H1 evidence. Add PAR only as an unresolved candidate: current visual seeds may compile a bounded UnifiedDB/EAP ActiveAssembly before semantic decode, but retrieved context must never outrank observed sensor evidence.

Implement matched visual differential around current Qwen/mmproj path and the new visual-seed EAP path. Prove end-to-end latency/utility, wrong-seed failure behavior, shuffled/stale controls, and whether EAP-guided active sensing beats a direct visual uncertainty baseline.
Treat EAP/visual memory as context-only candidate evidence. Measure whether associative context improves GWT candidate quality while wrong-memory controls do not create false ignition.

Ensure ClayCode can type PerceptualMemorySeed, visual evidence epochs, UnifiedDB basis/hash, EAP selection certificates, semantic-change routing and active sensing without allowing retrieval salience to become truth or authority.

Study visual-seed graph activation as a derived possibility projection. Preserve wrong-seed/shuffled-topology controls and negative-space blocking; graph coherence is relevance evidence, never perception truth.

Test EAP as perceptually triggered ActiveAssembly compiler: high-confidence visual refs seed bounded possibility retrieval. Keep exact/FTS routes as baselines, report complete end-to-end latency instead of calling EAP latency-free, and preserve canonical StateLedger authority plus stale epoch/hash rejection.
Keep alternative memory-coupling geometries open: no EAP, direct memory, EAP reflex, specialized visual transient index. Collapse only from matched evidence.

Use lesions/rescues/shuffled graph/wrong seed to test whether perception-memory coupling contributes causal task benefit beyond additive retrieval and whether feedback creates pathological self-confirming loops.

q23 is a discoverable domain_research branch. Add Retina/Qwen↔UnifiedDB/EAP perceptual retrieval coupling to whole-mesh synthesis as a user-proposed candidate, explicitly not a fixed architecture premise.
